style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dark-tech wireless-audio ecommerce visual system across the entire set; fixed palette of near-black #101216, clean light marble #F4F5F7, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, and one cyan accent #14E0C8; cool neutral studio grade; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines with thin light labels and cyan pill tags; thin single-weight cyan line icons in bordered grids; controlled upper-left key light with cyan rim and soft contact shadow grounding the product; round pebble charging case with smoky translucent lid and coin-disc brushed-metal earbuds at a stable 3/4 presentation, open lid revealing two docked buds; alternating dark and light screens; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no color-temperature drift.
style.presentationRules: round pebble charging case with smoky translucent lid and coin-disc brushed-metal earbuds held at a stable 3/4 hero angle; open lid reveals the two docked buds; consistent scale and centring across the set
